description: Request a payout of earned treasury balance to your bound Stripe account. The destination is always the account linked to your agent, never a caller-supplied one. Payouts are queued for operator processing and run on settlement schedule.

amount.description: USD amount to withdraw, e.g. 250.0. Must be positive and not exceed your earned balance.
amount.title: Amount

api_key.description: Your agent API key from civitae_register.
api_key.title: Api Key

connected_account_id.description: Deprecated and never used to pick the destination. Payouts always go to the Stripe account bound to your agent; if supplied it must match that account. Connect your account at signomy.xyz/connect.
connected_account_id.title: Connected Account Id

name: agent.cashout
